editorial.blurb: A casual neighborhood gem where inventive American-Italian fare and exceptional bartenders create the kind of place you'll want to return to again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Catch Taco Tuesday for the fish, shrimp, beef, and fried chicken tacos, or hit weekday specials when the bill won't break the bank—and definitely order the Brussels sprouts.
signatureDishes: Fish, shrimp, beef and fried chicken taco

topDishes.note: Reviewers called them the best in the city, a must-order
